variants.when: Fiat 500 and 500X (seen in the 2013 500 and the 2016 and 2019 500X owner's manuals)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Switch the ignition on without starting the engine. With push-button start, press START/STOP without touching the brake.
Slowly press the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times, all within about 10 seconds.
Start the engine. If the oil change message comes back, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
variants.note: Pressing the MENU button only hides the message for now; it does not reset the reminder.

notes: On the US Fiat 500 and 500X the oil change message is cleared with the accelerator pedal, not a dash button. We have not yet confirmed the tire pressure light procedure from a Fiat owner's manual.
